Name: Attractive Standard Farm (CP)
Author: youjin0207
Description:
[center][b][color=#f6b26b][size=5]This mode provides beautiful farm terrain.[/size][/color]


[/b][size=5][color=#e69138][b]You can build many kinds of buildings. [/b][/color]
[/size]
[size=3]: Barn(2), coop(2), silo(2), shed(1), slime hutch(1), stable(1), fish pond(2 or more), mill(1), shipping bin(2 or more), etc.
[/size]

[color=#b45f06][b][size=5]How To Install
[/size]
[/b][/color][b][size=3]1. Download the file and open the zip file
[/size][/b]
[size=3][b]2. Paste it into stardewvally > [/b][color=#ff0000][b]Mods

[/b][/color][/size][b][size=3]3. Start a new game and choose the [color=#ff0000]Standard farm.[/color]
And play fun!
[/size][/b][color=#e06666]

This mode does not include map recolor assets and building retexture. It contains only vanilla tile sheets, so I recommend you download them separately.[/color][/center]
